name: study-tracker
description: Lets Claude read your lectures and save concepts, questions, flashcards and study sheets into the Study Tracker app on this Mac.
long_description: Study Tracker keeps your timetable, deadlines, course materials and flashcards on your Mac. This extension gives Claude restricted access: it can read your schedule and lectures, and save concepts, practice questions, proposed flashcards, Cornell sheets and gap reports back into the app. It cannot delete anything, and assignments or study blocks it suggests wait for your confirmation. Nothing leaves your Mac except what you share in the conversation.
